egress_register.name: Provider API calls through the self-hosted OAuth broker
egress_register.known_gap: The proxy checks that a linked account exists for the call, not the tenant's sub_processor_opt_in; what it sends is whatever the calling action or sync puts in the request. Authorization is the calling action's own policies and the tenant's link to the provider.
egress_register.notes: Credentials never travel in the request body: the broker injects the provider token. Telemetry carries structural names only.

egress_register.name: Model calls through the guarded client

gate.name: Deployment-wide in-zone flow guard (REQUIRE_IN_ZONE_MODELS) plus the paste guard, and a call record for every call

egress_register.known_gap: The tenant's recorded sub_processor_opt_in is not consulted on this path: with the flow guard off, a hosted model is called for any tenant. The opt-in is enforced on the judgment path (model_calls_judgment), not here.
egress_register.notes: The call record holds caller, profile, model, residency and counts, never a prompt or an output.

egress_register.name: Judgment evaluations through the judgment model wire

gate.name: Residency policy: a sub-processor instrument is refused unless the tenant recorded an opt-in, and refused for everyone under the flow guard

egress_register.notes: Unknown tenants and unknown residency classes are refused.

egress_register.name: Assistant and agent runs

gate.name: Only the in-zone model profile runs: any other profile is refused before a call is built

egress_register.known_gap: An in-zone refusal needs the operator's in-zone profile to be configured; the tenant's sub_processor_opt_in plays no part, because the path never reaches a sub-processor.

egress_register.name: Design-time catalogue translation (mix l10n.generate)
egress_register.known_gap: Calls the model client directly, outside the guarded client and its call record. It sends only catalogue strings and a glossary from this repository, and is run by a person at a terminal, never by the application or CI.

egress_register.name: OpenLineage run events

gate.name: Off unless an HTTP collector is configured; events carry table-level names only, never actor, tenant or values

egress_register.notes: A failed post is logged and dropped; the audit log, not the collector, is the record.

egress_register.name: Account mail (confirmation and password reset)
egress_register.known_gap: No tenant-level gate. A message goes to the address of the user the action is for, and carries a single-use token link. Which mail provider receives it is a deployment choice (default: local mailbox).

egress_register.name: Sign-in through the deployment's OpenID Connect identity provider (ADR 0071)

gate.name: The strategy is declared only in a build that sets OIDC_BASE_URL, and talks only to the issuer configured at runtime

egress_register.notes: ash_authentication's oidc strategy (through assent) fetches the issuer's discovery document and keys, and exchanges the authorization code with this application's client id and secret and a PKCE verifier. The provider returns the person's claims; no tenant data is sent to it.

egress_register.name: Standards check: model runtime version probe

gate.name: Off unless the standing job is enabled; the target is the configured in-zone profile's own host

egress_register.notes: A GET of the runtime's version. No tenant data.

egress_register.name: OpenTelemetry trace export

gate.name: No exporter runs unless OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set; model-call spans carry no prompt or output content

egress_register.notes: Configured in config/runtime.exs; there is no Elixir call site to scan.

egress_register.name: Golden-record export to a customer's system

gate.name: The egress grant (a read grant on the egress resource), the tenant's active egress mapping, public attributes only

egress_register.notes: Produces rows for the tenant's own use; this module sends nothing over the network itself.

egress_register.name: Audit package for an auditor

gate.name: Reads run under the exporting person's actor and tenant, so what the export holds is what that person's grants reach

egress_register.notes: A directory of files written by a mix task; there is no export as the system and none across tenants.

gate.name: Disclosure gate: refuses the send unless the tenant, the readable disclosure reference and the residency policy allow it
